# Restaurant Guru

> > Restaurant Guru is a global restaurant discovery platform offering reviews, ratings, menus, and local dining recommendations across multiple languages and locations.

Restaurant Guru serves as a comprehensive restaurant discovery and review platform with multilingual support across major markets including the US, Europe, and beyond. The platform combines user reviews, restaurant ratings, and location-based search to help diners find the best dining options nearby, while also offering business tools for restaurant owners and managers.

## Main Platform

- [Best Restaurants 2026 Near Me - Restaurant Guru](https://restaurantguru.com): Restaurant Guru homepage for discovering restaurants, reviews, menus and ratings near you.
- [Business](https://restaurantguru.com/businessLanding): Restaurant Guru business account landing page for restaurant management and marketing.
